name: se.norli/norli-mcp
title: Norli
description: Airbnb rental income estimates, guides and service areas for Stockholm and Sörmland, Sweden.

tools.name: hyresuppskattning
tools.description: Estimate the monthly short-term rental (Airbnb) booking income for a home in Sweden, from property type, bedrooms and postcode. Returns a rounded monthly range in SEK, a link to Norli's full report, and whether Norli manages this type of home in the area.

bostadstyp.description: Property type: lagenhet (apartment), villa (detached house), radhus (townhouse), fritidshus (holiday home/cottage).

postnummer.description: Swedish postcode, five digits, e.g. 11122 or 111 22.

tillval.description: Optional features: pool_spabad (pool/hot tub), sjotomt (lakefront/seafront plot), vattennara (near water), hog_standard (high standard), balkong_uteplats (balcony/patio), egen_parkering_garage (private parking/garage).

sprak.description: Language of texts and links: sv (Swedish, default) or en (English).

tools.name: sok_guider
tools.description: Search Norli's published guides on renting out a home via Airbnb in Sweden: tax, insurance, pricing, cleaning, renting to companies, and guides per area. Returns titles, links and excerpts.

sprak.description: Language of texts and links: sv (Swedish, default) or en (English).

tools.name: omraden
tools.description: Which areas of Sweden Norli takes on, with the property types per area and links to Norli's published area guides.
